artists.biography: Held By Trees is an instrumental post-rock collaboration of musicians from the United Kingdom. The music is heavily inspired by Talk Talk and Mark Hollis. Many musicians that took part in the infamous sessions for Talk Talk's Spirit of Eden (1988) and Laughing Stock (1991), as well as Mark Hollis' solo album (1998), collaborated on Held By Trees' début LP, Solace (2022). Other inspirations include the minimal piano work of Ryuichi Sakamoto and early 1970s Pink Floyd. Read more on Last.fm. Held By Trees.biography: Held By Trees is an instrumental post-rock collaboration of musicians from the United Kingdom. The music is heavily inspired by Talk Talk and Mark Hollis. Many musicians that took part in the infamous sessions for Talk Talk's Spirit of Eden (1988) and Laughing Stock (1991), as well as Mark Hollis' solo album (1998), collaborated on Held By Trees' début LP, Solace (2022). Other inspirations include the minimal piano work of Ryuichi Sakamoto and early 1970s Pink Floyd. Read more on Last.fm. release_name_discogs: Eventide / Solace - Live At Real World Studios

perplexity.description:
Eventide / Solace – Live at Real World Studios is a 2023 live album by Held By Trees, released on Sound Canyon Records. The album captures the group’s atmospheric and introspective sound, blending elements of post-rock, ambient, and art rock with lush instrumentation and subtle improvisation. Recorded at Peter Gabriel’s renowned Real World Studios, the performance features the core touring lineup and highlights the band’s signature use of piano, woodwinds, and layered guitar textures, creating a meditative and immersive listening experience.

This release follows the group’s acclaimed 2022 debut album Solace and their 2023 EP Eventide, both of which established Held By Trees as a distinctive voice in contemporary British rock. The live setting allows the band to expand on the studio recordings, emphasizing the organic interplay between musicians and the emotional depth of their compositions. The album was well-received for its evocative soundscapes and refined musicianship, reinforcing Held By Trees’ reputation for crafting thoughtful, genre-blurring music that resonates with fans of atmospheric rock and post-rock.
